content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Columbus

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary degree and completion of project management education — no work experience necessary. Columbus professionals entering project management, career changers, and those supporting roles at major employers like Nationwide, JPMorgan Chase, and OhioHealth can qualify immediately. Verify your secondary credential and you're ready to move forward.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format condenses the required project management education into a focused, interactive experience. You'll learn core concepts, terminology, and frameworks directly from active certified practitioners — all online, on a schedule that fits your Columbus work calendar.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your education hours, apply directly to PMI for CAPM candidacy and pay the exam fee. The application process is straightforward and conducted through PMI's online portal. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application steps so you move forward confidently.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy offers exam-preparation support to reinforce your knowledge and build test-taking confidence. The CAPM exam tests your understanding of project management processes and best practices. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner and complete it at a proctored center or approved remote location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM is valid for three years from issuance. To renew, earn professional development units (PDUs) by engaging in ongoing project management education and activities. PDU requirements are designed to keep your skills current as you advance your career in Columbus's growing project-driven industries.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
